model.usage2_say_nobody_reads: Created in {files}; no file reads it (a panel or a plugin may)
model.usage2_card_check_say: Created but no file reads them. Often normal: a panel or a plugin may read them. Look at them and mark them.
model.usage2_card_check_maybe_say: Some are read and not created in the folders read. Read the missing folders to be sure.
model.usage2_cause_read_unread_folder: Read, and a folder that could create it was not read
model.usage2_cause_read_unread_folder_do: Probably nobody creates it yet. Read the folder that is missing; if it is still not created, create it.
model.usage2_cause_created_not_read: Created, and no file reads it
model.usage2_cause_created_not_read_do: Normal if a DWC panel, a plugin or the console reads it. If you are not sure, look at where it is created and mark it as reviewed.
model.usage2_cause_live_not_in_files: On the machine, in no file read
model.usage2_cause_live_not_in_files_do: Something else created it (the console, a file outside what was read). Switch its folder on in What to read, or mark it as reviewed.
model.usage2_reviewed_note: Marked in this browser; nothing was changed on the machine.
model.usage2_all_looked: Everything that was left has been looked at.
model.alerts2_alias_hint: Optional, up to 40 characters. It is shown instead of the path in the list, the banner and the message.
model.alerts2_scope_short: It only watches while DWC is open in a browser.
model.alerts2_rule_empty_form: Fill in the path and the limit to add a rule.
model.alerts2_full: The rules are full ({n} at most). Remove one to add another.
